card.title: How to Fix an iPhone 8 Plus boot looping on apple logo and random charging

source.title: How to Fix an iPhone 8 Plus boot looping on apple logo and random charging

claims.statement: Normal iPhone 8 / 8 Plus pre-boot draw ramps about 0.020 → 0.080 → 0.200 A; jumping straight to 0.200 A suggests a fault in the Hydra / Tristar / PMIC path.
With logo loops and erratic charging and a warm Hydra USB IC, test the charge port flex and front camera first, then replace Hydra.

procedure: Inspect around Hydra, Tristar and the battery connector.
Swap charge port flex and front camera.
Replace Hydra if issue persists; confirm normal ramp and charging.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
